decision: The competitor (Aston Martin Red Bull Racing) is fined €400.
event_name: Aston Martin Red Bull Racing Document 49 Date 08 July 2018 Time 15:58 2018 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Car 3 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 80 km/h for this Event by 3.8 km/h. Fine imposed as the offence occurred after the race had finished. Tim Mayer Mumtaz Tahincioglu Tom Kristensen Steve Stringwell
rules_referenced: Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Doc 49 2018 British Grand Prix Offence Car 3 Pit Lane Speeding
